mission.goal: Deploy an operational objective-preserving Sovereign Execution Boundary without allowing partial artifacts to substitute for the outcome.
mission.workflow: compile mission -> decide policy -> route provider -> verify semantics -> record proof -> commit or quarantine
mission.data: Validated MissionIR and purpose-limited provider responses; hash-chained JSONL event lineage.
mission.interface: Python API, HTTP API, container health endpoint
mission.stack: Python 3.11+ standard library; optional OpenRouter HTTP adapter; Docker
mission.environment: Local containerized reference runtime with external effects disabled
mission.governance: Formation A2, zero recurring cost, no credentials, no production effects
mission.failure: Typed failures, bounded retry, failover, quarantine, cancellation and rollback
mission.testing: Unit, integration, API smoke, failure-first, idempotency, tamper and security tests
mission.deployment: Kubernetes and container definitions supplied; live production proof remains mandatory and open
mission.continuity: README, Formation spec, project memory, AI handoff, ledger replay

assumptions.storage: Local JSONL ledger; PostgreSQL remains the production extension
assumptions.authentication: External effects disabled; provider credentials absent during qualification
assumptions.deployment: Container definition supplied but no production deployment claimed

components.database: Append-only JSONL ledger for dependency-free reference; PostgreSQL is production target
components.queue: In-process serialized mission path; Temporal task queues are production target
components.worker: SovereignEngine synchronous worker with provider adapters
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: no recurring automation in reference boundary
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: no policy or provider cache in reference boundary
components.authentication: External effects disabled; provider key read only from environment when explicitly enabled

observability.correlation_ids: mission_id, request_id, decision_id and event hash
observability.health_checks: GET /health validates ledger integrity and effect state
observability.structured_logs: JSON HTTP access logs and structured ledger events
observability.metrics_alerts: Reference exposes state in ledger; OpenTelemetry/Prometheus adapter remains production extension

testing.unit: Mission validation, policy, routing, ledger and effect broker
testing.integration: Engine-provider-ledger and live local HTTP server
testing.fixtures_mocks: Programmable mock providers with typed injected failures
testing.failure_first: Outage, transient, refusal, malformed output, semantic failure, authorization, secret route, duplicate effect, failed readback and tamper
testing.results: 23/23 unittest cases passed in 1.027 seconds; compileall passed

delivery.file_tree: README.md, FORMATION_SPEC.md, PROJECT_MEMORY.md, AI_HANDOFF.md, BUILD_CONTRACT.json, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, pyproject.toml, seb/, tests/

continuity.checkpoints: Every ledger event is a hash-chained checkpoint
continuity.resume_conditions: Valid ledger chain and active mission not cancelled/quarantined
continuity.stop_switch: process stop, mission cancellation, policy denial, semantic quarantine

proof.semantic_verification: Local mock route, policy denial, provider failover, quarantine, idempotency, effect readback and ledger tamper controls verified
proof.deployment_readback: OPEN_REQUIRED: the owner objective requires operational deployment; no live runtime is available in this execution environment
